prompt_md: Ana can paint a fence alone in 3 hours. Ben can paint it alone in 6 hours. Working together at those paces, how many hours does it take them?
prompt_short: Ana paints a fence in 3 h, Ben in 6 h. Together?
hint_md: How much of the fence does each paint in one hour?
explain_intuition_md: Together they must be faster than Ana alone, so anything over 3 hours is out. In an hour Ana does a third and Ben a sixth, which is half the fence.
